Why us

Three things we do right.

01

Baked through the day

Puffs come out of the oven in small trays, not one big morning batch. Hot means hot.

02

Kopi the old way

Beans roasted dark, pulled through a sock, sweetened the way your grandfather liked it.

03

Order ahead, skip the queue

WhatsApp your order, get a pickup code, walk in and walk out. Ten minutes, tops.
